value.stringValue: AND( NOT(ISBLANK([FPC_Funding_del__c].Opportunity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK([FPC_Funding_del__c].Opportunity__c.AccountId)), OR( [FPC_Funding_del__c].Opportunity__c.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MCA_Oppty', [FPC_Funding_del__c].Opportunity__c.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'FRPSA' ), [FPC_Funding_del__c].Calculator_User_Type__c = 'External Lender', [FPC_Funding_del__c].Lender_ID__r.Name <> 'MLP', ISCHANGED([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c, 'Declined'), ISPICKVAL([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c, 'Lender Pend Info'), ISPICKVAL([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c, 'Lender Approved'), ISPICKVAL([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c, 'Older Approval'), AND( ISPICKVAL([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c, 'Approved'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE([FPC_Funding_del__c].Status__c), 'Lender Approved'))) ) )
